evidence.title: Globe Telecom SEC Form 17Q – 1Q 2026: STT Cavite 2 Update
evidence.publisher: Globe Telecom, Inc. via Philippine Stock Exchange EDGE
evidence.attribution: Globe Telecom, Inc. and Philippine Stock Exchange EDGE
evidence.excerpt: Globe's first-quarter filing says STT Cavite 2 Phase 1 reached ready-for-service status with active customer deployments in place.

metadata.content_hash_scope: SHA-256 of the exact 1460276-byte public official filing attachment response body
metadata.phase_1_status_as_reported: ready-for-service status, with active customer deployments already in place
metadata.physical_status_scope: Ready-for-service plus active deployments supports operational for the delivered Phase 1 scope as of quarter end. It does not establish completion or operation of every later STT Cavite 2 phase or the full campus.
metadata.capacity_context_as_reported: STT GDC Philippines was positioned to exceed 30MW of total capacity within the year.
metadata.capacity_guardrail: The >30 MW platform forecast is untyped and cross-site. The 40.5 MW partnership is energy-procurement context. Neither creates a Cavite facility capacity row.
metadata.capture_guardrail: The filing, extracted text, headers, and curl writeout were deleted after exact validation and are not redistributed.

evidence.title: STT GDC Philippines Calabarzon Data Centres
evidence.excerpt: The current Calabarzon page places STT Cavite 2 in General Trias and reports 6 MW of IT load.

metadata.content_hash_scope: SHA-256 of the exact 70549-byte public official HTML response body
metadata.capacity_scope: The 6 MW facility-card value is typed as IT load and is normalized as planned full-facility capacity; the filing does not allocate it to Phase 1 or establish that all 6 MW is operational.
metadata.status_guardrail: The page's marketing label may describe the full facility and does not negate the later-period filing's operational Phase 1 evidence. It is not used for lifecycle classification.
metadata.capture_guardrail: The credential-free body, raw headers, and curl writeout were deleted after exact validation.

capacities.notes: Full-facility IT-load card value. It remains planned because only Phase 1 is documented ready for service with active deployments; the filing does not report how much of 6 MW is installed, energized, operational, or measured.
